title: Oracle restoration at the bookmarked cell
statement: For every Boolean input word $x$, tape content $f$, integer $p$, side and verdict bits, valid input-head position, and output word, running the oracle-dispatch machine for two steps from the ready configuration containing the one-letter verdict word in read state yields the back configuration at position $p$ with bookmark $0$, depart state carrying the verdict and the side value that is absent when $p=0$ and otherwise equals the given side; the input-head position and output are preserved.
